description.value: A resort campground directly on Hwy 23 North near Nakusp, offering caravan/camping sites with access to mineral-rich lithia hot springs, spa, and poolside café; fees apply and weekend stays have a two-night minimum.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags the site as a caravan_site with tents=yes, drinking_water=yes, power_supply=yes, and toilets=yes; however, the website describes only cabin, chalet, and cottage accommodations with no mention of tent camping or RV hook-up sites, so camping-specific amenity claims from OSM tags alone are treated cautiously. The website confirms an active resort with an on-site restaurant (Chanterelle Restaurant and Poolside Cafe) and an online booking system (IQ-WebBook), and corroborates the local phone number 250-265-3554. The address 5655 Hwy 23 North Nakusp, BC V0G1R0 is sourced from the website, as OSM has no address field populated.
concerns: OSM email field contains a typo: 'info@halcyon-hotspings.com' (missing 'r' in hotsprings); correct email is likely info@halcyon-hotsprings.com.
Website lists only cabin/chalet/cottage accommodations with no mention of tent sites or RV/caravan hook-ups; OSM tags tents=yes and caravan_site may be inaccurate or outdated.
OSM address field is empty; address sourced from website (5655 Hwy 23 North Nakusp, BC V0G1R0) and not cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established resort with hot springs accessible to non-overnight guests, on-site dining, and a scenic location on a key cycling corridor (Hwy 23 Arrow Lakes route); a notable restorative stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Hot springs are explicitly open to non-registered day visitors as well as resort guests, which is a notable draw for passing cyclists who may not be staying overnight.

wow_evidence: mineral-rich lithia hot springs, spa, and poolside café; accessible to non-overnight guests
